d: ET looks back at Drew Barrymore's decades-long career in never-before-seen interviews  from her start in "E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial," to her rom-coms and her own daytime talk show.
In-depth and revealing conversations with the biggest and brightest stars in Hollywood.

Each episode gives viewers an inside look at television, film and music, including interviews with each industry's biggest stars. Over the years, many celebrities have "broken their silence" regarding various scandals or tragedies with hosts and correspondents from "ET." In addition to covering breaking news, the show visits sets of movies and TV shows and heads to the red carpet to cover awards s
